«Square Avatars» changes photo shapes. «Compact List» reduces avatars and padding. «Sticker Size» scales stickers in chat (10–200%). «Original Telegram Icons» adds them to the icon picker. «Round Buttons» removes text under profile buttons. «Profile Color» uses the profile color as background. «Avatar Blur» shows a blurred background when zooming in on an avatar.

«Border» adds a thin frame around each message. «Transparent» hides the background — only text is visible. «Semi-transparent» makes the background 70% visible. «Liquid Glass» replaces bubble backgrounds with blur. Options are mutually exclusive.
Deleted messages stay semi-transparent in chat with a 🗑 icon. Deleting again removes them permanently.
The original text is shown crossed-out below the message. The ✏️ icon next to the timestamp indicates an edit.
«Deleted Cache» removes view markers. «Edited Cache» erases edit history. «Saved History» resets deletion markers (messages saved via «Save Chat History»).
Choose the default camera for video circles.
Each option is independent. «Read on Action» marks messages as read when any interaction with a contact occurs.

«Disable Ads» hides sponsored messages. «Protected Content Bypass» unlocks forwarding, screenshots, and saving media from protected channels; view-once content stays; removes blur from paid media. «Scammer Protection» warns in profiles from the Whitegram scammer database.

«ID & DC» adds technical data to profiles. «Seconds» shows exact timestamps. «Full Views» shows the real number (1,234 instead of 1K). «Hide Phone» removes the number from your profile. «Creation Date» shows when a channel/group was founded.

«Formatting Toolbar» shows formatting buttons above the keyboard. «Translate» always shows the translate button regardless of language. «Max Speed» increases parallel downloads to 16. «Save History» saves deleted messages to a local database — restore chats via the «More» menu in a contact's profile.
Allows you to hide unwanted sections from Telegram settings. At least one core section must remain visible.
Hides unwanted tabs from the bottom navigation bar. «Labels» removes text under icons. «Height»/«Width» scales the bar (50–150%). Restart required.
Displays a custom star count in your profile. Visual effect only — real balance is unchanged.
Tap «Select Font File» and open a .ttf/.otf file directly from the Files app. The font applies after a restart.
Saves authorization keys in iOS Keychain. After reinstallation, tap «Restore» to log in without re-authorizing.
«Last Online» remembers approximate activity time even when the status is hidden. «Read Date» saves locally when a message was read.
Shows the current system state. The «Copy Diagnostics» button copies the full report to the clipboard.
JS plugins extend Whitegram without rebuilding. Plugins run in an isolated JavaScriptCore environment.

Stay in chat after being banned

After a ban the chat is not closed and does not turn into a stub: the title and photo are kept, the already downloaded history stays readable, and the "you are no longer a member" bar is hidden. New messages will not arrive — after a ban Telegram's server stops serving that history, and no client can work around it.
